title: Great Plague of Vienna
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Great Plague of Vienna", at revision 1272266851, opens: "The Great Plague of Vienna occurred in 1679 in Vienna, Austria, the imperial residence of the Austrian Habsburg rulers. From contemporary descriptions, the disease is believed to have been bubonic plague, which is caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis, carried by fleas associated with the black rat and other rodents. The city was crippled by the epidemic, which recurred fitfully into the early 1680s, claiming an estimated 76,000 residents." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q448015, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "epidemic". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
